# Doc-Engine

Doc-Engine is a documentation workflow system that connects source code and documentation through two-way pointers, a searchable index, and a controlled tag vocabulary.

Code documentation location: `spek-fu\project\code-docs`.

## Glossary

**dok-fu/dokfu** - previous name of the plugin.

**index** — `spek-fu/project/code-docs/index.json`. A flat JSON array of `{path, tags[], description}` entries covering all doc modules. Regenerated by `dokfu index`. Never hand-edited.

**module** — A single doc file at `spek-fu/project/code-docs/<mirrored-folder>.md` that documents one **source directory**. Contains YAML frontmatter (with `code:` pointing to the folder) and H2 sections, one per source file in that folder.

**comment** — A single-sentence inline annotation inside a source file. The `dok-fu:` pointer comment near the top of a file is a special comment that links the source file to its doc module.

**section** — An H2 heading inside a module that documents one specific source file within the module's folder. The section header is the filename; the first body line is `path: <repo-relative path>` to that file.

**pointer** — The two-way link between a source file and its parent module. The source file holds a `dok-fu:` comment pointing to the module doc; the module frontmatter holds a `code:` field pointing to the source folder. Both must agree.

**tag** — A short label from `spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/knowledge/tags.registry.json` attached to a doc module's frontmatter. Used for index search and AI-assisted traversal. Unknown tags are rejected by the scripts.

**traverse** — The act of navigating the documentation hierarchy (index → modules → comments → code) to gather relevant information with minimal context load. Implemented as the Doc-Engine Traverse (`doc-engine-traverse`) skill.

**enrich** — The act of filling documentation gaps: adding missing code pointer comments, creating missing doc modules, and adding missing index entries. Implemented as the Doc-Engine Enrich (`doc-engine-enrich`) skill.

**update** — The act of synchronizing doc modules and comments with recent source changes. Uses `dokfu changes` to identify stale files. Implemented as the Doc-Engine Update (`doc-engine-update`) skill.

**maintenance** — The act of changing the doc-engine plugin itself (skills, agents, scripts, knowledge files) and verifying pointers, file inventory, and scripts stay consistent. Implemented as the Doc-Engine Maintenance (`doc-engine-maintenance`) skill.

**drift** — The state where a doc module, code comment, or index entry no longer accurately reflects the current source code. Detected by `dokfu doctor`.

**orphan** — A doc module whose `code:` pointer points to a source folder that no longer exists, or a source file with a `dok-fu:` comment whose target module no longer exists. Also applies when a module has a section for a file that has been deleted. A broken pointer with a matching `dokfu_id` in another doc is a *rename candidate*, not an orphan. Reported by `dokfu doctor`.

**root.md** — A special doc module at `spek-fu/project/code-docs/root.md` that documents source files at the project root (not inside any subdirectory). Its frontmatter uses `code: .` to point to the root directory. Mirrors the same structure and pointer rules as other doc modules.

**rename candidate** — A source file whose `dok-fu:` pointer target no longer exists, but a doc module with a matching `dokfu_id` was found at a different path. Detected by `dokfu doctor`; repaired by `dokfu doctor --fix-pointers`.

**dokfu_id** — A stable slug in doc module frontmatter derived from the source folder path (e.g. `src/auth` → `src-auth`). Used by `dokfu doctor` to match broken pointers to renamed or moved doc modules.

## How to use

The main doc-engine entry point is the `doc-engine-executor` agent in `.claude\agents\doc-engine-executor\AGENT.md`. The agent chooses the right skill to consult based on context:

`doc-engine-traverse` - Use whenever doing research, analysis or exploring code to load relevant context of the project.

`doc-engine-enrich` - Use whenever new files were added or pre-existing source files lack doc pointers, documentation or index entries.

`doc-engine-update` - Use whenever source files changed and/or docs are stale - always after implementation.

`doc-engine-maintenance` - Use whenever the doc-engine plugin itself needs to change (skills, agents, scripts, knowledge files) or its integrity needs auditing.

### Choosing the right skill

- **Unsure which skill fits?** → Doc-Engine Owner (`doc-engine-owner`), the facade entrypoint that routes to the right sub-skill(s) below.
- **Exploring unfamiliar code?** → Doc-Engine Traverse (`doc-engine-traverse`)
- **New file added / doc gaps detected by `dokfu doctor`?** → Doc-Engine Enrich (`doc-engine-enrich`)
- **`dokfu changes` returned a non-empty list?** → Doc-Engine Update (`doc-engine-update`)
- **Pointer broken / file renamed?** → Run `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py doctor` to detect rename candidates via `dokfu_id` matching; run `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py doctor --fix-pointers` to auto-repair pointer comments in source files; then run `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py index`
- **The doc-engine plugin itself needs a change or a health check?** → Doc-Engine Maintenance (`doc-engine-maintenance`)

See `spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/skills/doc-engine-maintenance/SKILL.md` for maintaining the plugin itself and `spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/knowledge/format.md` for the format specification.

## Commands reference

**Invoking the CLI:** run all commands as `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py <command>` from the project root.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py index` | Rebuild `spek-fu/project/code-docs/index.json` from all module frontmatter |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py index --check` | Exit non-zero if index is stale |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py tags --list` | Print all tags in the registry with explanations |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py tags --search <TAG>` | List doc paths that carry the given tag |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py doctor` | Validate pointers, tags, and index freshness; report broken/orphaned |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py doctor --json` | Same as above, machine-readable JSON output |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py doctor --fix-index` | Also rebuild index if stale |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py doctor --fix-pointers` | Detect broken pointers; for rename candidates, update pointer comments in source files |
| `python spek-fu/plugins/doc-engine/scripts/dokfu.py changes [--since <REF>]` | List source files changed since ref (git primary, manifest fallback) |
